method: Latest successful per-class measurements, with worst observed costs as defaults and Flink-line overrides. Unobserved older classes retain fallback-source hints; unseen classes cost one second. Scheduling hints only.

canonical_source.method: Maximum observed XML class seconds across the complete successful JDK 11/17 matrix with first-tier compilation and job-local class metadata sharing. All 116 runnable classes measured; two abstract bases retain zero cost. Scheduling hints only.

runtime_source.method: Maximum observed class report seconds across successful JDK 11/17 jobs on each Flink line. Restricted to compiled runtime partition inventories; repeated boundary-phase reports use the maximum. Missing helper classes retain their default cost. Scheduling hints, not performance or passing-test evidence.

fallback_source.method: Maximum observed class report time across completed and interrupted Flink/JDK shards, grouping nested names under their outer class. Scheduling hints, not passing-test evidence.
